source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/mcmullenandsons/macsclassicmenu04 (all 11 tabs via ?mguid, downloaded fresh 2026-10-08; robots.txt of menus.tenkites.com disallows only /fonts/, /views/, /*.less$)
not_verifiable: kJ, fibre and weight are not printed by the page, so none are published or compared; the page prints no ingredient lists, only a short description per dish (used for the allergen cross-check)
notes: Fresh re-run of the script reproduced data/source exactly. Independent read: every dish modal (559 across 11 tabs) read through Chromium's DOM (a different method from the script's HTML parse) and each of the 226 published items compared on the 7 printed nutrients, contains/may-contain and the cereal/tree-nut kinds: 0 differences (thousands separators such as '1,119' aside). 7 more rows held back: Gluten Free Bread & Butter (0.1 g carbs: butter only), 3 seabass rows (12 g / 3 g protein with 46-63 g sugars for a fish fillet), Duck Bon Bons (smoky mayo, no egg marked), 2 festive Roast Turkey rows (buttery gravy, no milk marked). 16 audit flags marked ok (huge-protein roasts: kcal agrees with macros; GF-labelled brownies; vegan-labelled ice cream; custard). Caveat: the page's GF dishes are served with a 'non-gluten bread & butter' that the chain labels vegan, so no milk is marked there (kept).
